description: This file defines application configuration settings loaded from environment variables for a Python-based backend, including a Settings dataclass and a function to retrieve and parse environment variables.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable dataclass holding application configuration parameters such as database URL, JWT secret details, CORS origins, and development admin enabling flag.

methods.name: List[str] _split_csv(value: str)
methods.description: Utility function to split a comma-separated string into a list of trimmed, non-empty strings.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Function that loads configuration settings from environment variables and returns a Settings object populated with those values.
